products.title: CozyAir Scent Diffuser
products.body_html:
Diffusing helps to reduce dust, pet dander allergens, and other airborne allergens from non-living matter.

The capacity of the machine is designed to be 500ml

Dimensions: 6 3/8" x 3 3/4" x 9 3/4"

products.title: La Tour Scent Diffuser
products.body_html:
The scent is diffused through nebulization, a process that breaks down fragrance oil into a very fine dry mist. This preserves the intention behind our essential oil blends and their olfactive and therapeutic powers without diluting the oil in water, heating it, or adding solvent to it.

The capacity of the machine is designed to be 120ml

Dimensions: 4 3/8" x 47 1/4''
